title: Reporting Delivery Method
description: Provider-neutral durable reporting delivery method. The caller may request protocol-managed provisioning or reuse an existing seller-issued binding. Transport names are open so new platforms do not require an AdCP enum change. Credentials, bearer profiles, and private keys MUST NOT appear. Sellers implementing this schema MUST advertise media_buy.reporting_delivery in experimental_features.

pattern.description: Immutable file/object publication with a manifest-last commit boundary.

transport.description: Storage transport such as s3, gcs, azure_blob, or sftp.

orchestration.description: Party responsible for starting and monitoring the transfer. Independent of destination ownership and the service that copies bytes.

pattern.description: Producer-hosted relation or share read through the intended recipient's access path.

transport.description: Sharing transport such as delta_sharing, snowflake_secure_sharing, or bigquery_authorized_view.

orchestration.description: Party responsible for configuring and monitoring the share.

pattern.description: Exact-revision publication into a warehouse relation or partition.

transport.description: Warehouse or transfer transport such as bigquery, snowflake, databricks_sql, or gam_bigquery_transfer.

orchestration.description: Party responsible for starting and monitoring materialization. consumer_managed covers platform transfer services that physically write consumer-owned tables.
